label: Incriminating Character of the Item Was Not Immediately Apparent
motion_heading: The Incriminating Character of the Item Was Not Immediately Apparent

review_conditions.display_note: You aren't sure yet whether the item's nature was immediately obvious. This section was drafted anyway; get the officer's account of what they saw or felt and what they did next before filing, or cut this section.

rule_statements.text: A warrantless seizure of an item in plain view is permitted only if the item's incriminating character is immediately apparent.
That requires probable cause to believe the item is contraband or evidence of a crime, without any further search.
The same limit applies to items detected by touch: an object felt during a lawful pat-down may be seized only if its contour or mass makes its identity as contraband immediately apparent.

practice_notes: Look for any step the officer took before being sure what the item was — a field test, a closer look, a question to your client. Each one suggests the character wasn't immediately apparent.
